card.name: Digits and splits inside dates and names
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a year, date or long name, such as the first digit of a year after a month, or the middle of a brand or drug name. Often appears in Wikipedia citation notes and in drug labels.

modes.label: Years in citation dates
modes.description: The digit or space just before the rest of a year in a month-year note or retrieval date.

modes.label: Inside drug or brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug or brand name that is split into several parts.

modes.label: Leading dose digit
modes.description: The first digit of a dose number in dosing text.
